room_rent.note: Base plan covers any room category. Optional Room Rent Modification add-on allows downgrade to Single Private AC, Shared, or General Ward for premium discount.

icu.note: ICU charges covered up to sum insured as part of inpatient treatment.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment on base covers. Voluntary co-payment (10%/20%/30%/40%/50%) available as optional cover for premium discount. OPD reimbursement claims carry 20% co-pay.

sub_limits.display: No sub-limits (base); optional sub-limit cover available
sub_limits.note: Base plan has no disease-wise sub-limits. Optional Cover 45 introduces sub-limits on Neurological, Heart, Auto-Immune, Cancer, Renal diseases and long bone fractures. Home Care Treatment capped at 10% of SI or ₹5L; Nanotechnology at 25% of SI; Bariatric Surgery has specific limits.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible. Voluntary Aggregate Deductible available as optional cover for premium discount.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day initial waiting period; not applicable for accidents or if continuously covered for 12+ months.

ped_waiting.note: Neo Plan: 36 months base, reducible to 24 or 12 months via paid optional cover. Prime Plan: 24 months base, reducible to 12 months via paid optional cover. Insta Care Cover reduces PED for 4 specific conditions (Asthma, BP, Cholesterol, Diabetes) to 30 days.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Reducible to 12 months via paid optional cover (Cover 41). Covers cataract, ENT, thyroid, hernia, joint replacements, gynaec conditions, calculi, etc.

maternity.note: Normal delivery: ₹25K–₹1L; Caesarean: ₹50K–₹2L depending on SI. Waiting: 2 years continuous coverage for both spouses or 4 years for insured woman alone. Max 2 deliveries lifetime. Assisted Reproduction Treatment also available as separate optional cover.

cumulative_bonus.note: 100% of SI if no claim in previous year; 25% of SI if claim made. Non-cumulative (resets each year). Enhanced Multiplier 3X or 10X optional cover provides additional cumulative bonus up to 3x or 10x SI irrespective of claims.

restoration.note: Automatic restoration of 100% of SI each time for unlimited times, triggered on partial or full utilization. Can be used for same or different illness including accidents and modern treatment. Unutilized restoration does not carry forward.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for up to 90 days before admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for up to 180 days after discharge.

day_care.note: All day care procedures/treatments covered up to sum insured.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to sum insured for treatment exceeding 3 days. Excludes Asthma, Bronchitis, Diabetes, Hypertension, Epilepsy, psychiatric disorders, and several other conditions.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient hospitalisation covered up to sum insured. Yoga and Naturopathy require prior company approval.

organ_donor.note: Donor complications (redo surgery/ICU) covered in addition to SI with 24-month waiting period. Insured's organ donation expenses covered up to SI.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to sum insured for transport to hospital, between hospitals, or hospital to residence (same city). Air ambulance available as optional cover up to 10% of SI.

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy, intravitreal injections (max 3/eye/period), deep brain stimulation, balloon sinuplasty, bronchial thermoplasty, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, and others covered up to sum insured.

consumables.note: 68 consumable items per Annexure-I plus admission/record/insurance processing charges covered if optional cover 28 opted. Inbuilt under Prime Plan.

global_cover.note: Territorial limit is India only. Accidental Death & PTD optional cover applies worldwide.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except for proven fraud.

grace_period.note: 15 days grace for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or portability.

portability.note: IRDAI-mandated portability with credit transfer for PED, specific waiting periods, NCB, and moratorium period.

notable_exclusions.display: Venereal/STD diseases (excl. HIV/AIDS), dental unless accident-related, refractive error <7.5D, EECP/chelation/hyperbaric O2 therapy, autologous SVF/PRP injections, erectile dysfunction, biologicals (OPD), congenital external anomalies

optional_riders.display: Insta Care (PED from day 31), Enhanced Multiplier 3X/10X, Delivery Expenses, ART, Consumables, OPD benefit (4 tiers), Air Ambulance, Accidental Death & PTD, Voluntary deductible/co-pay, Sub-limits cover, Advance Access, Wealth for Health, Premium Promise
